title: Cyberpsychology & Digital Behavior
summary: Cyberpsychology: digital identity, online behavior, social media, internet addiction, cyberbullying, virtual identity, and digital behavior.
objectives: Explain digital identity and online disinhibition.
revision: Cyberpsychology: digital identity, online behavior, social media, internet addiction, cyberbullying, virtual identity.
traps: Cyberpsychology = human behavior in digital/tech contexts.
Internet addiction = excessive use interfering with daily life.

notes.t: The study of the human mind and behavior in the context of human-technology interaction, including online behavior and digital environments.

i: Virtual identity: persona in virtual environments

notes.t: Excessive internet use that interferes with daily life, relationships, and functioning.
Bullying or harassment conducted through digital technologies and online platforms.
Social media affects self-esteem, social comparison, and well-being, with both positive (connection) and negative (comparison, anxiety) effects.
UGC NET may ask about cyberpsychology, digital identity, and internet addiction.

mnemonics.title: DISB
mnemonics.text: D — Digital identity (online self), I — Internet addiction (excessive use), S — Social media (connection/comparison), B — Cyberbullying (online harassment)

flashcards.a: Excessive internet use interfering with daily life.
